# CalculateAnything - Complete LLM Index

> Complete documentation and capability index of all 110+ client-side tools on CalculateAnything.

## Overview

CalculateAnything provides client-side computational utilities across date/age, math, finance, unit conversion, developer formatting, productivity, and image processing.

### Age Calculator
- **URL**: https://calculate-anything.in/tools/age-calculator
- **Category**: Date & Age Calculators
- **Description**: Calculate your exact age in years, months, days, hours, and minutes from your date of birth. Find out how many days until your next birthday.
- **Keywords**: age, birthday, date of birth, years old, calculate age
